color.note: Every value is a multiple of #111111, so it lands on one of the e-ink panel's 16 levels. Night is an exact inversion of paper.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Screen background everywhere.

tokens.name: paper-shade
tokens.usage: Raised panels (menus, the status bar strip) and the pressed fill of secondary buttons.

tokens.name: smudge
tokens.usage: The selected row in a list, the ground of a toggle that is off.

tokens.name: hatch
tokens.usage: Strokes and fills without words: hatching, unread progress, disabled outlines. 3:1 or better on paper, never for text.

tokens.name: pencil
tokens.usage: Secondary text (authors, values, hints) on paper, paper-shade and smudge.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, icons and outlines on paper, paper-shade and smudge; the fill of primary buttons and stickers.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill (primary button labels, stickers).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Outlines, separators and hand-drawn rules. An alias of ink.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one title on a screen: the library header, a menu page title.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Shantell Sans for every label, row and number.

styles.name: menu
styles.usage: Menu items, tab labels, button labels.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Book titles in lists, settings text, dialog body.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Authors, values on the right of a row, hints. Usually in pencil.

styles.name: book
styles.usage: Book text. Pick Literata as KOReader's reading font.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its label, sticker padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls; the pitch of hatching.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a row's icon and text, between related items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutters, dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Minimum height of anything tappable.

radius.note: Plain radii for small things; boxes use the wobble shapes.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Sticker corners, the checkbox.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cover thumbnails when wobble would be too busy.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Toggle tracks and knobs, dots.

shadow.note: Hard paper-cut shadows only. Blur turns to grain on e-ink.

tokens.name: shadow-cut
tokens.usage: Dialogs and primary buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-cut-sm
tokens.usage: Stickers and cover thumbnails.

wobble.note: Border-radius shapes that make a box look hand-drawn. Alternate a and b between neighbours.

tokens.name: wobble-a
tokens.usage: Buttons, cover thumbnails, the active-tab ring.

tokens.name: wobble-b
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the next button in a row.

tokens.name: wobble-pill
tokens.usage: Toggle tracks and long pills.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Separators and hatching.

tokens.name: stroke-pen
tokens.usage: Control borders: buttons, checkboxes, toggles.

tokens.name: stroke-marker
tokens.usage: Dialog borders, the active-tab ring, read progress.

tokens.name: tilt-left
tokens.usage: Stickers like "new".

tokens.name: tilt-right
tokens.usage: A second sticker or doodle nearby.
